reason: An evidence-driven workflow plugin for AI coding agents that routes substantive software tasks through bounded planning, diagnosis, implementation, inspection, and work-item modes with explicit completion evidence.

summaries.zh: 为 AI 编程代理提供基于证据的软件工程工作流，将实质性任务路由到有界的规划、诊断、实现、结构检查或工作项管理模式。
summaries.en: Provides evidence-driven software engineering workflows for AI coding agents, routing substantive tasks into bounded planning, diagnosis, implementation, structural inspection, or work-item modes.

capabilities: Routes substantive software tasks into bounded engineering workflows
Defines evidence requirements for diagnosis, design decisions, implementation, structural inspection, and work-item planning
Provides validation commands and runtime entry points for Codex and DeepSeek Harness
